shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal band(s) of small repeated elements
occasional figural motif amid otherwise non-figural surface
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief with at least one horizontal band of small repeated units — rows of inscribed signs in A, a narrow ornamental strip of repeated motifs in B — which is a very generic correspondence. The decisive difference is content: A is essentially an expanse of registered script/symbol rows with almost no figural imagery, while B is dominated by a large-scale figural relief (a bearded head with a rounded headdress and curled hair rendered in beaded rows) set above the band, so no shared iconographic scheme is evident.
